task_summary: Implement a set of shared UI components in TypeScript/React: CodeBlock (with copy-to-clipboard), VersionBadge (pill/badge styling), YouTubeEmbed (iframe embed), CalloutBox (variant-styled callout), and a utility function extractYouTubeVideoId. Must fix prior test failures around clipboard handling (async vs sync return) and missing 'rounded' class on VersionBadge.

findings.finding: navigator.clipboard.writeText() returns a Promise. When clipboard is unavailable (navigator.clipboard is undefined), the fallback must also return a Promise (or at minimum, the handler must be async and the test must not use .resolves on a non-Promise). The prior failure was caused by returning a plain boolean instead of a Promise from the copy handler when clipboard is unavailable. The correct pattern: make the click handler async, guard `if (!navigator.clipboard)` and return early (resolve with a failure result), never return a raw boolean where a Promise is expected.
findings.source: MDN Web Docs - Clipboard API; prior test failure analysis
findings.relevance: Directly fixes the TypeError: 'You must provide a Promise to expect() when using .resolves, not boolean'

findings.finding: The prior implementation used classes like 'font-semibold mr-1' but omitted any 'rounded' variant (e.g., 'rounded', 'rounded-full', 'rounded-md'). The contract test explicitly checks that the badge element's className includes the substring 'rounded'. The fix is to ensure the outermost span/element includes a rounded class such as 'rounded-full' (standard pill/badge pattern) in Tailwind.
findings.source: Prior test failure analysis; Tailwind CSS badge/pill patterns
findings.relevance: Directly fixes the AssertionError about missing 'rounded' class

findings.finding: YouTube URLs come in many formats: youtube.com/watch?v=ID, youtu.be/ID, youtube.com/embed/ID, youtube.com/v/ID, youtube.com/shorts/ID, and with additional query params or timestamps. A robust regex pattern: /(?:youtu\.be\/|youtube\.com\/(?:embed\/|v\/|shorts\/|watch\?.*v=))([\w-]{11})/ captures the 11-character video ID. Edge cases: URLs with extra params (&t=, &list=), URLs with 'www.' or 'm.' subdomains, URLs with protocol variants (http vs https).
findings.source: Stack Overflow consensus patterns; YouTube URL specification
findings.relevance: Core utility function needed by YouTubeEmbed component

findings.finding: YouTube iframes should use youtube-nocookie.com domain for privacy, include sandbox attribute, and set allow='accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture' with allowFullScreen. The src should be constructed from the extracted video ID only, never from raw user input, to prevent XSS via crafted URLs.
findings.source: OWASP iframe embedding guidelines; YouTube embed documentation

findings.finding: Standard callout/admonition variants are: info, warning, error/danger, success, tip/note. Each maps to distinct Tailwind color classes (bg, border, text). Use a discriminated union or string literal enum for CalloutVariant. A CalloutVariantClassMap record maps each variant to its styling classes. Pattern: Record<CalloutVariant, string> for the class map.
findings.source: Docusaurus admonitions pattern; common design system patterns
findings.relevance: Defines the type structure and styling approach for CalloutBox

findings.topic: React component testing with vitest and @testing-library/react
findings.finding: Use @testing-library/react's render() and screen queries. For clipboard tests, mock navigator.clipboard as an object with writeText: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined). For the 'clipboard unavailable' case, set navigator.clipboard to undefined via Object.defineProperty. Use fireEvent.click or userEvent.click, then await the result. Never use .resolves on a non-Promise value.
findings.relevance: Directly relevant to writing correct tests that avoid the prior failures

findings.topic: Named exports only, no default exports
findings.finding: Per project standards, all components must use named exports: `export function CodeBlock(...)` or `export const CodeBlock = ...`. Never use `export default`. Types must use `export type { }` syntax.

The ClipboardWriteResult struct should represent success/failure of clipboard operations. Common pattern: { success: boolean; error?: string }. The copy handler should always return Promise<ClipboardWriteResult> regardless of whether clipboard is available, ensuring consistent async behavior and preventing the prior .resolves TypeError.
findings.source: Functional error handling patterns; prior failure analysis
findings.relevance: Ensures consistent async return type from copy functionality

recommended_approach:
1. **Types file** (`src/shared_ui/types.ts`): Define all types first — CalloutVariant as a string union (`'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' | 'tip'`), props interfaces for each component, ClipboardWriteResult as `{ success: boolean; error?: string }`, CalloutVariantClassMap as `Record<CalloutVariant, string>`, YouTubeUrl as a branded/plain string type.

2. **extractYouTubeVideoId** (`src/shared_ui/utils.ts`): Pure function using a comprehensive regex. Returns empty string on no match. Validate the 11-char ID format.

3. **CodeBlock** (`src/shared_ui/CodeBlock.tsx`): Renders a `<pre><code>` block with optional language label. Copy button's click handler MUST be `async` and MUST return `Promise<ClipboardWriteResult>`. When `navigator.clipboard` is undefined, resolve with `{ success: false, error: 'clipboard_unavailable' }` — never return a raw boolean. Use state to show copy feedback.

4. **VersionBadge** (`src/shared_ui/VersionBadge.tsx`): Renders a `<span>` with classes that MUST include `rounded-full` (or `rounded-md` at minimum — but `rounded-full` is the standard pill pattern). Include `font-semibold`, `text-xs`/`text-sm`, `px-2`, `py-0.5`, `inline-flex`, and the rounded class. This directly fixes the prior test failure.

5. **YouTubeEmbed** (`src/shared_ui/YouTubeEmbed.tsx`): Uses extractYouTubeVideoId to sanitize input. Renders a responsive iframe wrapper (`aspect-video` or 16:9 padding trick). Uses `youtube-nocookie.com` for privacy.

6. **CalloutBox** (`src/shared_ui/CalloutBox.tsx`): Accepts variant prop, maps to Tailwind classes via CalloutVariantClassMap constant. Renders bordered/colored container with icon area and children.

7. **Barrel export** (`src/shared_ui/index.ts`): Re-export all named exports. Use `export type { }` for type-only exports.

8. **Tests**: Ensure CodeBlock clipboard test uses `await` on the handler result (which is always a Promise). Ensure VersionBadge test finds `rounded` substring in className.
alternatives_considered: Using a third-party syntax highlighting library (e.g., prism-react-renderer) for CodeBlock — rejected because it adds a dependency and the spec doesn't mention syntax highlighting, just code display with copy
Using react-youtube or lite-youtube-embed for YouTubeEmbed — rejected to keep dependencies at zero and maintain full control over the iframe security attributes
Using 'rounded-lg' vs 'rounded-full' for VersionBadge — chose 'rounded-full' as it's the standard pill/badge pattern in Tailwind and guarantees the 'rounded' substring match the test expects
Returning void from copy handler instead of ClipboardWriteResult — rejected because the test uses .resolves which requires a Promise return value
risks: The contract tests may expect specific class names beyond 'rounded' — we need to ensure all Tailwind classes match what tests assert
The clipboard mock in tests must be carefully set up: Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'clipboard', ...) can be sticky across tests if not cleaned up in afterEach
YouTubeEmbed iframe may not render in jsdom test environment — tests should assert on the iframe element's src attribute rather than visual rendering
If the test file already exists and has specific assertions, our component implementations must match those exact expectations rather than our assumptions
compliance_notes: All files must be .ts or .tsx — no Python
TypeScript strict mode — all public functions must have type annotations
Named exports only — no default exports anywhere
Use 'export type { }' for interfaces and type aliases
vi.mock() factories must provide every named runtime export of mocked modules
No external service dependencies in tests
Every function must have at least one test
All contract tests must pass before task is complete
